- scripts/validate_process.sh:3804-3825 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The credential-scrub deduplication compares `-u NAME` array entries against bare variable names, so existing entries are never recognized and duplicates are appended.
  WHY: Duplicate `env -u` arguments are functionally harmless, but the deduplication intent is defeated and the array grows unnecessarily.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:324 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `judge_interim_isolation_refuse` exits with status 0 when the review sandbox is unavailable.
  WHY: The workflow can treat the judge as successful despite no output being produced, causing downstream processing to fail on empty input.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:324-331 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `judge_interim_log_fail` records the hard-coded reason `isolation_unavailable` instead of distinguishing `sandbox_unavailable` from `sandbox_helper_outdated`.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish the two failure causes in the `JUDGE_INTERIM_PASS_FAIL` log.
- agents.md:1927 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `REVIEW_UTILITY_ISOLATION` documentation says `JUDGE_INTERIM` emits `engine=claude|codex`, although that role only emits `engine=codex` and rejects Claude.
  WHY: The documented contract suggests a log payload that cannot occur, so searches or monitoring based on it can produce false negatives.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1611, 1662-1670 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `target_root` is resolved without checking that `validation/tests` is not a symlink or that the resolved path remains inside `repo_root`.
  WHY: A restored manifest can pass `_safe_target` and cause `_write_new_file` to create the generated executable outside the intended directory.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/validate_process.sh
  Line or code reference: 3817-3818, the dedup loop inside `validation_harness_scrub_append`
  severity=NIT | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The dedup check compares `"${scrub_existing}"` (e.g. `-u GH_TOKEN`) against `"${scrub_name}"` (e.g. `GH_TOKEN`), so they never match.
  WHY: The array grows with redundant `-u TOKEN` entries for variables already in the fixed list; `env -u X -u X` is functionally equivalent, but the dedup intent is defeated and the array bloats.
- File: agents.md
  Line or code reference: 1927, the `REVIEW_UTILITY_ISOLATION` log-prefix row
  severity=NIT | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The documentation says the prefix is emitted with `engine=claude|codex` for `JUDGE_INTERIM`, but `scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:328` hard-codes `engine=codex` and `scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:264-266` rejects non-codex engines for that role.
  WHY: Anyone grepping logs for `engine=claude ... role=JUDGE_INTERIM` will never find a match; the documented contract overstates what the code can produce.
- Requirement: "otherwise implement an automated equivalent ... and say so in the PR body" (from the "Mitigation policy" section of issue #6821)
  Expected change site: PR description/body
  Evidence of absence: The PR description says "Automated implementation. Closes ... Refs #6664" but does not list the automated controls used. Every finding was addressed with deterministic, automated isolation (sandbox routing, credential stripping, O_EXCL materialization, body-content validation), none required human gates, and none of the finding rows starts with "HUMAN GATE REQUIRED:" — so the implementation satisfies the first clause, but the second clause (documenting this in the PR body) is unmet. The changelog fragment describes the controls in detail, but the issue explicitly asks for the PR body.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: scripts/validate_process.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 3804-3825, `validation_harness_scrub_append` dedup loop (`for scrub_existing in "${VALIDATION_HARNESS_CREDENTIAL_SCRUB[@]}"; do if [ "${scrub_existing}" = "${scrub_name}" ]`)
  severity=NIT | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The dedup check compares array entries (which include the `-u ` prefix, e.g. `-u GH_TOKEN`) against the bare env var name (`scrub_name=GH_TOKEN`), so every credential-shaped env var is appended again as `-u TOKEN` even when the fixed scrub list already contains it.
  WHY: The resulting `env -u GH_TOKEN -u GH_TOKEN ... env` is functionally equivalent to a single `-u GH_TOKEN`, so the security guarantee is not broken; the dedup intent is silently defeated and the array bloats by one element for every matching var in the environment.
- File: scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 326-331, `judge_interim_isolation_refuse`
  severity=NIT | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The function takes a granular `$1` reason (`sandbox_unavailable` or `sandbox_helper_outdated`) into the `::error::REVIEW_UTILITY_ISOLATION ... reason=$1` log line, but `judge_interim_log_fail` is hard-coded to `"isolation_unavailable"`.
  WHY: Operators reading the run log cannot distinguish a missing sandbox stub from an outdated helper in the `JUDGE_INTERIM_PASS_FAIL` line; the granular reason is available in the parallel `::error::` line.
- File: agents.md
  Line or code reference: line 1927, `REVIEW_UTILITY_ISOLATION` log-prefix row
  severity=NIT | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The documentation describes the prefix as emitted with `engine=claude|codex`, but `scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:328` always emits `engine=codex` for the `JUDGE_INTERIM` role, and `scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:263-265` explicitly rejects any non-codex engine for that role.
  WHY: A grep for `engine=claude ... role=JUDGE_INTERIM` over run logs will never find a match; the mismatch is documentation-only.
- Requirement: "Otherwise implement an automated equivalent (identity- and provenance-scoped authorization, fail-closed validation, least-privilege tokens, sandboxing) and say so in the PR body."
  Expected change site: PR description / PR body for issue #6821.
  Evidence of absence: The supplied PR description in the prompt is exactly "Automated implementation. Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/6821 Refs #6664" — it does not enumerate which finding each mitigation covers or identify the automated control applied (sandbox-only execution, env-flag + mount-path + network + credential guards, O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW materialization, regex-based credential scrub, etc.). The code and the changelog fragment document those controls, but the issue's mitigation policy requires the disclosure specifically in the PR body.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
